verdict.rationale: Greptile auto-reviews every PR (greptile-docs-1) and generates sequence diagrams/flowcharts for every PR to help parse complex changes (greptile-docs-17), plus a review summary with confidence score and Fix-All button (greptile-docs-13, greptile-docs-16, greptile-docs-3), directly supporting fast reviewer orientation; community evidence (greptile-comm-8) confirms real teams find it catches real issues before human review. Missing for 10: a concrete example of the actual auto-generated summary text/walkthrough output, and independent commentary specifically evaluating walkthrough/summary quality (most community feedback focuses on Q&A accuracy rather than PR summaries).
